english.notes:
(i) Section 5 of the Control of Pollution (Amendment) Act 1989 provides powers to search the vehicle in question, test anything found therein and seize the vehicle and contents.
(iii) This offence was inserted by section 37 of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit on prosecutions
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
